title: Median offered wage on H-1B applications
subtitle: Annualised lower bound of the wage offered, by quarter decided
takeaway: Awaiting data: no H-1B filings imported yet. Download a quarterly LCA disclosure file from the Department of Labor and import it (see Data & Methods).
assumptions: The wage is the lower bound the employer offered on the application, annualised (hourly ×2080, weekly ×52, bi-weekly ×26, monthly ×12).
It excludes equity and bonuses, which dominate pay at these companies, so it understates total compensation.
Entered by hand from the DOL file: each row shows who entered it and the case number.

sources.label: DOL H-1B Labor Condition Applications (imported quarterly file)
